fact: INEGE presented on 16 September 2025 the Informe de Hechos Vitales Guinea Ecuatorial 2024, the second edition of its vital events report (births and deaths; marriages and divorces); the text names no administrative source or edition of any other product (the source is vital events records, civil registration).
title: PRESENTACIÓN DEL INFORME DE HECHOS VITALES GUINEA ECUATORIAL 2024
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística de Guinea Ecuatorial (INEGE)
